description: Find software by name, task or recorded filters. Returns at most ten candidates from the same service as native HTML/HTTP search, with recordUrl and met/unmet/unknown requirement assessments. Unknown is not false. No complete profile, publisher fetch, bulk export or functionality guarantee.

category.description: Recorded category slug, including its descendants.

license.description: Recorded license family, not a verified legal conclusion.

limit.description: Same normalization as HTTP search; at most ten combined identities.

page.description: Same normalization as HTTP search; depth beyond 50 is refused.

platform.description: Recorded platform filter, using the HTTP search vocabulary.

pricing.description: Recorded pricing classification, not proof of a price.

q.description: Name or task; at most 512 UTF-8 bytes and 12 words. No model or translation is called.

require.description: Up to three requirements, e.g. api:true,mcp:true. Missing or inferred evidence stays unknown.

unknown.description: Defaults to include candidates needing verification.

name: search_catalog
